idea-plugin.name: DB Comment Search
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a DB Comment tab to Search Everywhere (double Shift) that finds database tables, views and columns by their comments — something the built-in Go to Database Object cannot do, because it matches object names only.

Very useful when your schema uses short or abbreviated object names and the real meaning lives in the comments (for example, comments written in Korean, Japanese or Chinese).

Features

  • Searches comments of tables, views and columns in every data source of the Database tool window
  • Works with any language, including non-Latin text such as Korean (한글)
  • Space-separated words are AND-matched, e.g. change request
  • Results are ranked: exact comment > comment starts with > comment contains > name match
  • Each result shows the object name, its comment and the data source / schema
  • Selecting a result navigates to the object in the Database tool window

Usage

  1. Press Shift twice and switch to the DB Comment tab (Tab)
  2. Type part of a comment
  3. Press Enter to jump to the table or column

To open the DB Comment tab directly, use Navigate | Search DB Comment... and assign your own shortcut in Settings | Keymap (search for "Search DB Comment"). Text selected in the editor becomes the initial query.

Notes

  • Requires the bundled Database Tools and SQL plugin (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, DataGrip and other paid JetBrains IDEs).
  • Comments are read from the IDE's introspected metadata, not queried live. If nothing is found, make sure the data source introspection level includes comments and refresh the data source (Ctrl+F5).

한국어

Search Everywhere(Shift 두 번)에 DB Comment 탭을 추가합니다. Database 도구 창에 연결된 데이터 소스의 테이블·뷰·컬럼을 comment(한글 포함)로 검색하고, 선택하면 해당 객체로 이동합니다. 공백으로 구분한 여러 단어는 모두 포함된 항목만 표시합니다. Navigate | Search DB Comment... 에 단축키(Settings | Keymap)를 지정하면 DB Comment 탭으로 바로 열 수 있고, 에디터에서 선택한 텍스트가 검색어로 채워집니다. comment가 검색되지 않으면 데이터 소스를 Refresh 하세요.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • New action Search DB Comment... (Navigate menu) that opens Search Everywhere directly on the DB Comment tab. Assign any shortcut in Settings | Keymap.
  • If text is selected in the editor, it is used as the initial search query.
  • If Search Everywhere is already open, the action switches to the DB Comment tab.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: DB Comment tab in Search Everywhere
  • Search tables, views and columns by comment (any language) or name
  • Multi-word AND matching and ranked results
  • Navigate to the selected object in the Database tool window

action.description: Open Search Everywhere on the DB Comment tab (search database objects by comment)
